decision_categories.INCONCLUSIVE: Stored provenance is insufficient to distinguish the mechanisms.
decision_categories.TRADE_TRIGGER_NOT_SUPPORTED: Failed pairs are not systematically associated with trade-triggered checkpoint mutations.
decision_categories.TRADE_TRIGGER_PARTIAL: Trade-triggered checkpoints explain a material subset but not all size divergences.
decision_categories.TRADE_TRIGGER_SUPPORTED: Size divergence is systematically associated with trade-triggered checkpoint mutations and the direction/side evidence is consistent with liquidity being consumed.

hypothesis.motivation: Official Polymarket market-channel documentation states that book events are emitted on subscription and when a trade affects the book, while price_change events are associated with new orders and cancellations.
hypothesis.statement: Some or all M2b exact-size divergences arise because the terminal ws_book is itself a trade-triggered state update. The trade-induced size mutation therefore need not appear in price_change rows preceding that ws_book.

important_methodology.next_milestone_if_cause_identified: Any remediation or new replay acceptance test must be frozen in a separate milestone after M2c is committed and stopped.
important_methodology.reason: M2c is a root-cause investigation, not a strategy test or an attempt to rescue M2b.

required_diagnostics.exact_event_time_trade: Record whether a same-token last_trade_event has exactly the same server event_time as the checkpoint ws_book.
required_diagnostics.pair_level_reconstruction: Reconstruct every M2b pair again only to recover the exact levels and size differences already tested in M2b.
required_diagnostics.pass_pair_control: Run the same trade-proximity diagnostics for the 84 exact-match pairs as a control.
required_diagnostics.sequence_trade_proximity: Where connection provenance exists, record checkpoint ingest_sequence minus nearest same-connection last_trade ingest_sequence.
required_diagnostics.server_time_trade_proximity: For each checkpoint locate the nearest same-token last_trade_event by absolute event_time distance.
required_diagnostics.size_direction: For each mismatched level record replayed size, checkpoint size, and checkpoint-minus-replay size.
required_diagnostics.trade_side_consistency: For associated last trades, test whether BUY aligns with ask-side liquidity reduction and SELL aligns with bid-side liquidity reduction.
